subject.title: feat(feeds): add publisher following control UI

question: Should OpenClaw core own signed publisher-feed following, scheduled refresh, gateway/CLI controls, and a Control UI, or should this capability be delivered through a plugin/ClawHub boundary?
rationale: The implementation is a large optional remote-service workflow spanning core runtime, persistence, protocol, CLI, and web UI; repository policy favors a lean core unless maintainers explicitly own the product and security boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the core capability
options.body: Keep the core design, but require the protocol-registry repair, upgrade proof, real behavior evidence, and review of the complete dependent stack before merge.

options.title: Move the workflow to an extension
options.body: Retain or add only the minimal generic extension seam in core and publish publisher-feed following as an independently maintained plugin or ClawHub package.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core capability
recommendation.body: Keep the core design, but require the protocol-registry repair, upgrade proof, real behavior evidence, and review of the complete dependent stack before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the identifiable author of the complete open stack; current-main feature ownership could not be traced after the read-only shell failed.
